Note: The two motor drivers are bought separately. USB carries commands from the Pi. The motor supply connects to POWER 12–24 V.

Note: The CAD specifies 14 countersunk M3 × 8 (#7213), 60 button-head M3 × 8 (#7219) and 54 square M3 nuts. Allow for display, camera and pulley hardware in the same lot.

Item: Kycon KPJX-PM-4S four-pin rear power inlet
Note: Panel socket for the external supply’s R7B DC plug. Check panel fit and room for the cable before printing the final enclosure.

Note: Select the 9–24 V input version. It converts 12 V to USB-C PD at 5 V / 5 A. The estimate assumes a spare 5 A USB-C cable.

Item: DFRobot DFR0758 USB charging module for the iPhone
Note: Dedicated to the iPhone 14. Use its USB-C port with the spare USB-C to Lightning cable.
Front on/off switch on the DC side of the console.
